title.p:
W / S — forward / back  ·  A / D — strafe
Mouse — look / turn  ·  Shift — sprint
Space — jump  ·  E — interact  ·  Left-click — attack (hold for power)
Right-click — block/parry  ·  F — cast magic  ·  I — inventory
Q — roll  ·  Middle-click or R — lock on (flick the mouse to switch foes)  ·  Ctrl — toggle sneak (reduces detection radius, slower move)

Press E near a cave entrance to descend into a dungeon.
Press E near a door to enter shops & trade.

archetypes.label: Warrior
archetypes.desc: A born fighter. Steel arms. Steady ground. You take a hit and stay standing.

archetypes.label: Sentinel
archetypes.desc: A patient defender. You don't strike first, but you outlast everyone who does.

archetypes.label: Duelist
archetypes.desc: Quick blade and sharper instincts. Footwork wins fights you didn't think you could.

archetypes.label: Scout
archetypes.desc: Light feet, sharp eyes. The road raised you. Luck keeps you on it.

archetypes.label: Monk
archetypes.desc: A disciplined soul. Where others tire, you find the breath in front of the next breath.

archetypes.label: Scholar
archetypes.desc: Books before blades. You understood the world before you learned to navigate it.

archetypes.label: Diplomat
archetypes.desc: A silver tongue. Most problems are conversations the rest haven't had yet.

archetypes.label: Vagrant
archetypes.desc: A drifter and a survivor. You've never owned a debt. Or a home.

sword.name: Wooden Sword
sword.desc: Balanced edge. The honest first sword.

club.name: Wooden Club
club.desc: Slow swing, heavy hit. Good against bone and stone.

staff.name: Wooden Staff
staff.desc: A walking-staff. Channels mana well — small spell-power passive while wielded.

bow.name: Wooden Bow
bow.desc: Strike from range. Draw to charge — a fuller pull hits harder and flies straighter. Comes with a quiver of iron arrows.

greatclub.name: Wooden Great Club
greatclub.desc: A heavy two-handed stick. Slow, brutal, single-target. Hold to commit a crushing power blow; can haft-parry without a shield.

finesse.label: Finesse
finesse.desc: Parry tighter. Strike from afar. Move unseen.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.desc: Outlast the long fight. Endure the unseen.

intelligence.label: Intelligence
intelligence.desc: Read more. Cast harder. Mana flows.

charisma.label: Charisma
charisma.desc: A silver tongue. Better deals all around.

fortune.label: Fortune
fortune.desc: The world favors you. Crits and chests.

peopleDesc: Fair, wiry, freckled. The home island's people; at ease anywhere the old tongue is spoken.
Tall, broad, pale. The Mark's people; warmer welcomes in the north, colder in the Compact's churches.
Olive, lean, quick. Aurenne's people; honoured in the ports, mistrusted where the gates are dug.
Grey-pale, black-haired, marked at the wrists. The makers' remnant. Nobody quite agrees what you look like.
